# Cloak of Protection (`magic-items:cloak-of-protection`)
**Category:** [Wondrous Items](../equipment-categories/wondrous-items.md) | **Rarity:** Uncommon | **Attunement:** Yes

Wondrous Item

You gain a +1 bonus to Armor Class and saving throws while you wear this cloak.
